title: ANF PolicyRecord
description: Authority-plane artifact (A0–A3). Authored by humans under governance processes; never produced by capability promotion. See knowledge-architecture.md §3 and ADR-001 Promotion Matrix.

approvers.description: Human approvers. A1/A2 require named approvers per governance process.

audit_refs.description: Independent audit records. Required for any policy whose origin traces to a capability proposal (K→A path), which otherwise defaults to prohibited.

guidance_refs.description: Capabilities that implement guidance derived FROM this policy. This is the ONLY permitted link between planes, direction: Policy → implementation guidance. There is deliberately NO field representing capability→policy promotion; adding one violates ADR-001.
